g.title: Medium shot. A street at dusk. Alice, centre, looking at Bob; Bob, centre, looking at Alice. Caption: The same street, years on. Alice: You haven't changed.
Medium shot. A street by day. Alice, centre, looking at Bob; Bob, centre, looking at Alice. Caption: Ten years earlier. Bob: Promise you'll come back.
Medium shot. A street at dusk. Alice, centre, looking at Bob; Bob, centre, looking at Alice. Bob: Neither have you.
